sentences.text: The South African Communist Party -LRB- SACP -RRB- is a communist party in South Africa .	communist party	communist party	South Africa	South Africa
It was founded in 1921 , was declared illegal in 1950 by the governing National Party , and participated in the struggle against ending the apartheid system .	apartheid	apartheid

It is a partner of the Tripartite Alliance with the African National Congress and the Congress of South African Trade Unions -LRB- COSATU -RRB- and through this it influences the South African government .	Tripartite Alliance	Tripartite Alliance	African National Congress	African National Congress	Congress of South African Trade Unions	Congress of South African Trade Unions
